title: diff-shared.custom.json
description: Per-repository overrides for diff-shared.sh: repo-local diff/merge tool preferences and per-file action overrides, keyed by file name.

diff.description: This repository's preferred diff tool/command, overriding the source-of-truth default.

merge.description: This repository's preferred merge tool/command, overriding the source-of-truth default.

action_overrides.description: Per-file action overrides. Each key is a bare file NAME (not a path -- no directory separators), matching the base name of a files[].targetFile entry in diff-shared.config.json; each value overrides the default action for that file in this repository.

tool.description: The name of the tool as it would be invoked on PATH (e.g. 'delta', 'code').

command.description: The full command line template used to invoke the tool. May reference $LOCAL/$REMOTE (diff) or $LOCAL/$REMOTE positions (merge).

action.description: The action diff-shared.sh takes for a file when it differs from the source of truth.
